articles.title: Shelton Powers Past Tiafoe to Reach Historic US Open Final
articles.summary: Ben Shelton came from a set down to beat Frances Tiafoe in an all-American semifinal thriller. He's the first Black American man in the US Open final since Arthur Ashe in 1972. He faces Zverev on Sunday.

articles.title: Space Junk Creates New Crater on the Moon
articles.summary: An old SpaceX rocket stage crashed into the Moon on August 5, 2026, creating a 60-foot-wide crater. Scientists are studying the impact to understand how space debris affects the lunar surface.

articles.title: MIT's Tiny 'HITMAN' Nanoantennas Could Target Brain Cancer
articles.summary: MIT researchers created injectable nanoantennas that use magnetic fields to kill glioblastoma cells. In lab and animal tests, the treatment shrank tumors and extended survival without side effects.
